profile.summary: nwoltman is a senior-level JavaScript developer with deep expertise in Fastify, specializing in backend architecture, performance optimization, and plugin development. Their contributions demonstrate mastery of Fastify's internals—including Request/Reply objects, hooks, middleware, and stream handling—alongside robust debugging, testing, and API design skills. The developer exhibits strong Node.js ecosystem awareness, particularly in Express compatibility and plugin systems, and has a proven track record of managing breaking changes and performance-critical code. Their work spans core framework improvements, documentation maintenance, and edge-case resilience, making them a trusted contributor to Fastify's development.
skill_evidence: "Always use a Request object when creating a Reply object" – Demonstrates deep understanding of Fastify's Request/Reply lifecycle
"Run onSend hooks when sending a stream" – Shows expertise in Fastify's stream processing and hook system
"Set req.originalUrl on each request" – Proves awareness of Express middleware compatibility in Fastify
"Add reply.notFound() method" – Evidence of API design improvements for plugin compatibility
"Simplify building Hooks and ContentTypeParser" – Performance optimization targeting Fastify internals
"Fix incorrect test" – Debugging experience with Fastify's test suite and CI failures
